thread:
maria (infra): hey @cloudops — hitting quota limits in westus3 while trying to spin up a high-density GPU nodepool for the recommendation engine canary.

maria (infra): current plan: 4 nodepools, 8 nodes each, using A100-80GB (1 GPU per VM). target initial GPU count = 32, burst to 64 for canary. also need secondary IP ranges / alias IP headroom for high maxPods (we set maxPods=110). cloud is returning quota errors: "acceleratorQuotaExceeded" and "IP_AMOUNTS_EXCEEDED".

maria (infra): example nodepool config we're trying to create:
```yaml
apiVersion: container.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1
kind: ContainerNodePool
metadata:
  name: gpu-hd-pool-1
spec:
  initialNodeCount: 8
  nodeConfig:
    machineType: n1-standard-32
    accelerators:
      - acceleratorType: nvidia-tesla-a100
        coreCount: 1
    metadata:
      disable-legacy-endpoints: true
    kubeletConfig:
      maxPods: 110
```

david (eng-infra): ack. can you paste the exact cloud error payload (request id) and which cloud account (bill-to) this is for? i'll open the internal ticket.

maria (infra): error id: 3f9a2c6b. account: acct-redwood-prod-2 (billing project: redwood-prod-core). I've attached the API response in the ticket draft link: https://redwood.internal/infra/quota-requests/1758884321

toni (cloudops): thanks — i'll submit the provider support case. template i use below, copy/paste and add details: 
Subject: Request increase for GPU accelerators and secondary IP ranges in westus3 for acct-redwood-prod-2
Body:
- Project: redwood-prod-core (acct-redwood-prod-2)
- Region: westus3
- Resource: GPU (A100 80GB) requested +64 accelerator quota (from 16 -> 80)
- Resource: VPC alias IP ranges / secondary IPs: +4 secondary ranges, +10k IPs headroom
- Justification: Launching high-density inference canary with maxPods=110 per node to pack GPU workloads and reduce network overhead. Need predictable capacity for weekend canary.
- Impact if not granted: blocked canary, delayed rollout, potential customer SLA risk.

toni (cloudops): I'll also flag the request as high-priority for network team — they often need the subnet expansion approved.

riley (cost): quick cost note: if we actually scale to 64 A100-80GB continuously that's ~ $X/hr (estimate attached). we should set autoscale policies to avoid sustained spend. recommend tag: cost-center=rec-eng and a daily budget alarm.

maria (infra): agreed — canary will be scheduled with aggressive scale-down and a 2h timebox. put me on the support case so i can confirm tests.

david (eng-infra): one more ask: can we reduce maxPods to 96 for the first run to avoid hitting CNI per-node ip exhaustion? Some clouds allocate more alias IPs per pod at high maxPods.

maria (infra): ok reducing to 96, i'll update the nodepool yaml.

sre-bot: deploybot detected pending resource-constraint alert for cluster "prod-westus3": GPUs quota 75% used, PodIP headroom 82% used. See: https://redwood.internal/monitoring/clusters/prod-westus3

sre-bot: auto-notify created support case: CASE-2026-04578 (provider ticket).

toni (cloudops): added both resource increases in the support case. support asked for account owner confirmation and estimated timeline. i'll ping legal and procurement for sign-off.

riley (cost): if you want i can set a short-term spend cap on the project to avoid surprises while the quota request is open.

maria (infra): please do. thanks all. :thumbsup:
